portableResolution.storedPaths: Every storedPath/path in archive inventory is repository-relative. Resolve from repository root, never from an old PC username or cwd.
portableResolution.rawSourcePaths: Absolute sourceFiles/sourceInventory/report paths inside raw originals are historical evidence and intentionally unchanged. Resolve references to archived inputs by originalBasename + originalSha256; do not execute those absolute paths.
portableResolution.reviewBinding: A review always binds to originalSha256; readable-view normalization is not substituted for its target.
portableResolution.staleSharedFiles: Original base/source hashes are historical. Reread current main and shared APIs before each implementation; do not overwrite current files using preparation snapshots.
portableResolution.missing: Missing review files are not considered approved. Add only finalized MD/JSON with target hash verification; preserve earlier raw originals.

privacyReview.scope: Only selected technical preparation/review files; no terminal logs, chat exports, full conversations, credentials or unrelated attachments.
privacyReview.manualInspection: Document headings, JSON schemas, review findings and all link destinations checked as technical plans/reviews. Existing local source paths and reviewer provenance IDs remain only in original reports as authorized; they are not treated as personal-contact data.
privacyReview.limitations: Pattern scan plus content/schema inspection, not a general DLP certification.

appendHistory.scope: Original bytes/verdicts preserved; E1 list-spacing and E2 inline-code placeholders/multiple-blank formatting only.
